question: Which of the following locations was among the venues that hosted the inaugural Khelo India Beach Games in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Diu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The inaugural Khelo India Beach Games were organized in **2025** to promote coastal sports and tourism in India.
 
• **Diu**, a coastal town known for its scenic beauty and rich heritage, was one of the venues chosen for this prestigious event.
 
• The games featured various beach sports such as beach volleyball, surfing, kiteboarding, and sand wrestling.
 
• The event aimed to encourage participation in beach sports and bring attention to India’s coastal regions as hubs for sporting activities.
 
• Participants from across the country competed in these games, fostering sportsmanship and cultural exchange.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme**:

 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in **2018**.
 
• Aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports played in the country.
 
• Focuses on identifying and nurturing young talent and providing them with necessary resources.
 
 
 
• **Beach Sports**:
 
 
• Beach sports are recreational or competitive activities held on sandy shores.
 
• Popular examples include beach volleyball, surfing, and beach soccer, which are designed to leverage the coastal environment.
 
• These sports promote physical fitness and draw attention to sustainable tourism practices.
 
 
 
• **Diu**:
 
 
• Located in the union territory of Daman and Diu, known for its Portuguese heritage.
 
• It is a popular tourist destination with beautiful beaches, forts, and rich cultural history.
 
• Chosen as a venue for the Beach Games due to its infrastructure and scenic appeal.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Khelo India Beach Games**:
 
 
• The games aim to promote fitness and sports culture in coastal regions.
 
• Encourage tourism and economic development in hosting cities or towns.
 
• Foster inclusivity and participation across diverse demographics.
